node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws using A,B,k and 1.7.2-1.7.3. Its polar-inverse component u_delta is the first component of the inverse in 1.7.4: both invert the same polar map Pi_delta, and the inverse of the diffeomorphism is unique. Therefore its formulas mu(U,V)=u_delta(U bold-dot V) and sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger) are C^1 on all required domains and obey the three exact identities and all five displayed estimates with right-hand side A*epsilon_r (alpha-renaming the lemma's third unitary to Z).
